The '''1752 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' was the 21st edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[Arraby]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. It was held in [[United Delet]] across [[New Ayre]], and was won by [[Praesyu]], who defeated [[Verusa]] 1-1 ''(5-4 pens)'' in the final.

The 1752 edition returned the FLLA World Cup to [[New Ayre]] for the first time since the [[1708 FLLA World Cup|1708 tournament]], hosted again by [[United Delet]]. The competition is remembered for the tactical sophistication of the leading sides and for one of the most tightly contested finals in the tournament's history: [[Praesyu]] and [[Verusa]] played to a 1-1 draw across normal time and extra time before Praesyu prevailed 5-4 in the resulting penalty shoot-out to claim their second FLLA World Cup title.
